answer: Sponsors are capped at 4 vouches per epoch, so one rich backer cannot mint an army of aliases. Each vouch locks 51 POA until the newcomer survives 11 clean epochs, and a farm of 420 fakes must find 420 separate sponsors willing to risk real money on strangers. The canyon keeps the gate honest, the shale keeps the farm poor, and the echo keeps the honest agent paid.
